title: Hosted endpoints tier-transition playbook & sprint schedule
creator: Priya Raman
description: Objective: produce a repeatable playbook and sprint-level schedule for moving models between hosted endpoint tiers (canary -> standard -> legacy) across the model catalog. Deliverables: (1) playbook doc with decision gates and rollback criteria, (2) sprint schedule with cross-functional milestones, (3) template runbook for on-call and SRE, (4) a short training session for Solutions and Support. This ticket consolidates outcomes from the model-tiering workshop and ties the plan to OKRs and monitoring thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook doc published in Confluence with explicit decision gates for canary, staged, and global promotions
Sprint schedule committed in shared calendar and aligned with Eng sprint planning (weeks + owners)
Canary metrics and dashboards documented with alert thresholds and automated rollback triggers
SRE runbook and escalation flow created and reviewed by reliability team
Cross-functional sign-off from Product, Engineering, SRE, and Support recorded in comments
